_comment: OPTIONAL DUMMY REFERENCE FRAGMENT — not a runtime config file and never loaded automatically. Merge this object into integrations in the private settings/settings.json only if the settings are not already present. Placeholder values only; do not store real secrets here.

weaponpaints_api._comment: Signed HTTPS client for the Linux WeaponPaints, SimpleAdmin, VIPCore and Ranks endpoints. Match the real runtime secret to the top-level shared_secret in /etc/fragcity-api/config.php. This one key is shared by these four endpoints; it must not be reused for either Pterodactyl integration.
